## Before you begin

Before you monitor MongoDB using Grafana Alloy, ensure that you have:

- A MongoDB instance up and running (local, cloud-hosted, or containerized).
- Network access between your Grafana Alloy installation and your MongoDB instance.
- MongoDB user credentials with monitoring permissions. Configure a separate user for Grafana Alloy with the [mandatory security privileges](https://github.com/percona/mongodb_exporter#permissions) necessary for monitoring.
- Access to the machine where you'll install Grafana Alloy.

If you are unsure of the architecture, perform the following steps:

a. On the Linux machine, open the Terminal.

b. Run the following command:

   ```
   uname -m
   ```

If this command returns `x86_64`, then select `Amd64`. If the command returns `aarch64`, then select `Arm64`. If the command returns anything else, your system isn't supported by Grafana Alloy; you need to use a 64-bit x86 or ARM system.

In this milestone, you install Grafana Alloy on your selected platform. Grafana Alloy collects MongoDB metrics and forwards them to Grafana Cloud for monitoring and visualization.

Before installing Grafana Alloy, you need to obtain your Grafana Cloud configuration details to establish secure communication between Alloy and your Grafana Cloud stack.
